---
name: Skill improvement
about: A repeatable failure or useful improvement, with sanitized evidence
---

## Request and skill

What task should the skill help with? Which version or commit did you use?

## Observed behavior

What did the agent actually do? Include minimal, sanitized evidence.

## Expected outcome

What observable result would count as success?

## Reproduction and scope

Which tools and runtime were available? Can this be reproduced with local fixtures?

Do not include credentials, account identifiers, private profiles, or customer data.
